items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Well, Abadra, that means good for nothing. Abadra is good for nothing.

ctx.x: And what were some of the expressions she taught you from Senegal?

Well, Abadra, that means good for nothing. Abadra is good for nothing. And good morning, Salikum, everybody, Serum. Salikum, Serum, that's good morning everybody. And at night, Balikum, Serum. And how's everybody home? Pelemete, Dumbaya, Kayaka.
And what did she call the puddings? What did she call the pudding that you made?
